sentences.text: The Gold Loan FAQ does not state any pre-payment charge percentage.

The Gold Loan FAQ says only that gold loans are granted against the security of gold ornaments pledged with the Bank, that the loan amount is a percentage of the assessed value of the gold ornaments, and that gold loans are granted for a period of up to 12 months.
